description.en: Schedules the training minigame (the lightning-bolt training spots) of the given type: a TRAINING request with that TYPE is queued and starts when the event ends.
Training type (the training sub-script passes its traType setting).

true once queued.
null if the request could not be queued, the script system is not ready or no argument is given.

examples.case: After the player accepts (real usage, from ie4_ev_sub_training.nut)
